description: This file defines the CandidateDao class, a data access object responsible for managing Candidate-related database operations in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying candidates, their histories, interviews, and associated entities, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: CandidateDao
classes.description: Data access object providing CRUD and query operations for Candidate entities and related entities within the recruitment context.

methods.name: getCandidatesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of candidates based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getCandidatesCount
methods.description: Returns count of candidates matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getCandidateById
methods.description: Fetches a Candidate entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCandidateIds
methods.description: Returns existing candidate IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves CandidateVacancy entity for a specific candidate.

methods.name: saveCandidate
methods.description: Persists a Candidate entity.

methods.name: saveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Persists a CandidateVacancy entity.

methods.name: deleteCandidates
methods.description: Deletes multiple candidates by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Deletes CandidateVacancy for a specific candidate.

methods.name: saveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Persists CandidateHistory records.

methods.name: getInterviewCountByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Counts interviews associated with a candidate and vacancy.

methods.name: saveCandidateInterview
methods.description: Persists an Interview entity.

methods.name: getCandidateIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of all candidate IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of all interview IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateIdListForHiringManger
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs for a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs for a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewById
methods.description: Fetches an interview by ID.

methods.name: getCandidateListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs assigned to an interviewer.

methods.name: getInterviewListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs assigned to an interviewer.

methods.name: isInterviewer
methods.description: Checks if an employee is an interviewer.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecords
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history records based on filter.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordsCount
methods.description: Counts candidate history records.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordByCandidateIdAndHistoryId
methods.description: Fetches a specific candidate history record.

methods.name: getInterviewByCandidateIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves an interview record by candidate and interview IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewIdsByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves list of interview IDs for a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of all candidate history IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history IDs for a hiring manager.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history IDs for an interviewer.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves vacancy IDs for an interviewer.

methods.name: getCurrentVacancyIdByCandidateId
methods.description: Gets current vacancy for a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Fetches candidate history for specific candidate and vacancy.
